The agenda began with it

Attendees were Chloe Ibrahim, Isaac Johnson, and Buddy.

The meeting opened with a brief review of current handling practice for companion animals moving through Aurelia Skyways. The team noted that carriers continue to be moved carefully between services, with attention to calm placement, steady handoff, and clear confirmation at each point. Staff also agreed that the desk ledger must reflect any service change at once so that the record remains accurate and usable across shifts.

The senior coordinator reported that intake checks were orderly, but that a few cases still require closer follow-up when documentation arrives incomplete. <<FACT F087>> The group accepted that the boarding process must remain consistent and that staff should avoid informal shortcuts. It was further noted that any concern needing escalation should be routed without delay. <<FACT F105>> The attendees agreed that this step should be used promptly whenever a transfer case shows signs of delay or mismatch.

Discussion then turned to traveler communication. The desk will continue to use clear wording, with brief guidance to owners and calm reassurance during handoff. Chloe Ibrahim and Isaac Johnson were cited as examples of the kind of careful coordination the team wants to preserve, while Buddy was mentioned as a reminder that animal comfort remains central to every service decision. The records aide noted that staff should keep remarks factual and concise when entering updates, especially where a change in service or handling occurs.

The meeting concluded with agreement to maintain present procedures, reinforce ledger discipline, and support prompt escalation when needed. The meeting ended in orderly fashion.
